response.overview: The film portrays a segment of Kosovar Albanian society in the 1990s, interwoven with events from the recent war in Kosovo. Among the characters featured is a prominent politician from the era of Ali Shukrija—a man who, as the child of a World War II veteran whose fate was unknown, had once served as a judge. Amidst the shifting political landscape of 1990s Kosovo, he took matters into his own hands to uncover his father's fate...
response.title: Viktimat e Tivarit
